The Big Red Book - Voter Guide November 3rd General Election
The Secretary of the Commonwealth's official voter information guide for the November 3rd State Election is now available.  Inside, you'll find important information and guidance about all nine state wide ballot questions.  Click the link below:
https://ma.omniballot.us/sites/25/vg/app/vig/voter-guide/instructions
Early Voting Hours for November 3rd State Election:
October 17th 9-3pm, October 19-22 830-430pm, October 23 830-12pm, October 24 9-3pm, October 26-29 830-430pm, October 30 830-12pm
DEADLINE TO REGISTER TO VOTE: Saturday October 24th 9:00AM-5:00PM
STATE ELECTION DAY HOURS: Tuesday, November 3rd 7:00AM-8:00PM

Public Records Request
Public Records Request Guidelines
Services:
Copies of vital records, Registrar of Voters, Town Meeting & Town Election Information, Census/Street Lists, Dog Licenses, Business Certificates, Raffle Permits, Physician Certificates, Annual Fuel Storage Registrations, Marriage Intentions, Justice of the Peace and Notary services.
Notary Public Service Guidelines
Please Note: No bills are sent out by the Town Clerk's office. If you have a question about a bill, please call the phone number listed on the bill.
